beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:c4.description: ABOUT BEACON SOFTWARE Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com/ is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies. They are niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore. Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently, accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable. We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better. Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game. ROLE AND MISSION This is an exciting and entrepreneurial opportunity to join a fast-paced technology company with a very significant growth trajectory. Beacon Software is making its first hire on the Strategic Finance team. This is a role where investing turns into building. The individual will report to Beacon’s VP, Strategic Finance and work closely with Beacon’s CEO, CTO, M&A Directors, industry pod leaders, and the General Managers of Beacon’s portfolio companies. The Strategic Finance team’s mandate spans the financial decisions that shape Beacon: partnering with portfolio companies on growth and value creation, building AI-native systems that let functions scale non-linearly with the portfolio, owning Beacon’s capital allocation across organic and inorganic strategies, leading new strategy extensions beyond core software M&A, and building Beacon’s capital markets capability. Team members work across a mix of these areas based on their interests and skillset. This is an asymmetric opportunity to build a company, with decision authority and velocity over process driving compounding equity. You’ll sit next to the CEO on capital allocation and capital markets, or fill a CFO role across dozens of companies on their most consequential decisions. The playbook will be shaped by you with the goal of building Beacon into a $100B company. To succeed in this role, this individual should be an enthusiastic and energetic self-starter, with the ability to translate operator intuition into financial decisions and build the analytical rigor behind Beacon’s platform-level bets. The ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously across portfolio companies and platform initiatives will be essential. We are seeking a collaborative professional who wants to contribute ideas on how to improve the status quo and create best-practices that will accelerate our execution. Teamwork and positivity are key foundations of this growing team’s culture and ethos. Location: for discussion. Beacon has offices in Toronto, San Francisco, New York, and Chicago. WHAT YOU'LL DO Finance partner to acquired companies - Partner with industry sector leaders and portfolio company General Managers as the financial decision-making engine across Beacon’s portfolio companies. - Translate product, AI, and operator intuition into investment decisions: pricing changes, sales hires, direct marketing investments, engineering allocation, and tuck-in M&A. - Build value creation plans, set budgets and targets, and make the day-to-day capital decisions that drive growth across companies. crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:58.description: Come join our team at Optimal! We know a few things about competing with giants and exceeding expectations. After years of working in the field, our founders decided to break from tradition and build the company they wanted to work for. They believed in starting a company rooted in trust, its team, and the idea that everyone matters and has a part in getting the job done right. Quickly building a reputation from the ground up and growing the company along with our list of clients, Optimal is now influencing the industry and the people we serve. We live by the values that make us who we are. And that is how we deliver the impossible for our clients and team members every day. The Pipefitters for Optimal Field Services will be responsible installing, maintaining, and dismantling all types of pipelines, fittings, and hydraulics, as required for new construction or maintenance. The employee will need to lay out, fabricate, assemble, and install/maintain piping systems for the jobsite. Pipefitters will be required to be able to measure and manipulate pipe using specialty tools or hand tools in order to ensure accurate production at all times. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: · Measure and mark pipes for cutting, threading, and welding. · Read and comprehend blueprints. · Selects type and size of pipe and related materials such as supports, hangers, and hydraulic cylinders according to job specifications. · Cuts pipe using pipe cutter, hammer and chisel, cutting torch and pipe cutting machine. · Threads pipe using threading machine. · Bends pipe using pipe-bending tools and machine. · Secures pipes to structure with bracket, clamps, and hangers, using hand and power tools. · Test piping systems for leaks by increasing pressure in pipes and observing gauges attached to pipes for indication of leaks. · Calculating dimensions and using basic math. · Diagnose and isolate troublesome distribution points and make corrective repairs; make emergency repairs to offset downtime and production delays. REQUIREMENTS FOR PIPEFITTERS: · Must have valid driver’s license/ Identification Card. · Must be able to read and interpret blueprint specifications. · Must be able to calculate dimensions and use basic math. · Minimum of 2 years of experience. · Must be able to pass a drug screen and physical.

You'll explore how technologies like MCP can unlock self-serve AI data access across the org, and ensure that as we adopt new AI capabilities, our data is ready to meet them. The rest of the company's AI ambitions run through you. What You'll Do: - Build and own the canonical data models in Snowflake that serve as Alchemy's company-wide source of truth — clean, queryable, and AI-ready - Structure datasets so vendor AI tools perform optimally out of the box, with consistent schemas, rich semantics, and well-indexed access patterns - Explore and prototype MCP integrations that let internal teams query data conversationally - Eliminate shadow tables and one-off datasets by proactively serving team data needs at the platform level, freeing data science to move faster - Own the transformation layer (dbt), with rigorous testing and validation so every downstream consumer — human or AI — can trust what they're working with What We're Looking For: - 6+ years in data engineering with strong SQL and deep Snowflake expertise - Experience designing efficient, scalable analytical data models - Proficiency with dbt or comparable transformation frameworks - Strong data quality instincts and a track record of building infrastructure that unblocks teams - Good judgment — you scope well, prioritize ruthlessly, and communicate tradeoffs - Experience in startups, a plus Benefits & Perks 🏥 Medical, Dental, & Vision 💪 Gym Reimbursement 🖥️ Home Office Build-out Budget 🥙 In-Office Group Meals 🚅 Commuter Benefits 🌴 Flexible Time Off 🧘‍♂️ Wellbeing & Mental Health Perks 🧠 Learning & Development Stipend 🌎 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events 💸 HSA and FSA Plans 🧬 Fertility Benefits More on The Role Alchemy is committed to offering competitive compensation, including base salary as well as equity. Additionally, Alchemy offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as other benefits such as 401k and unlimited flexible time off. The base salary range for this position is estimated to be between $200,000 - $240,000 annually. Please note this range reflects base salary only, and does not include bonus, equity, or benefits. Your salary will be determined by various factors, including relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business needs.

We are hiring a Tech Lead Manager to lead our Answer Engine Insights team in Buenos Aires. This is the team that decides how we collect and analyze AI model responses at scale, how we extract competitive signals, how we model visibility/sentiment/accuracy over time, and how we surface all of it in a fast, reliable product experience.
